# CogniFocus
> CogniFocus is a free focus timer and app blocker that reacts
> the moment you drift into TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, or other
> distracting apps. Built for Android. iOS coming soon.

## What CogniFocus does
CogniFocus combines a session-based focus timer with a Distraction
Shield that interrupts blocked apps in real time. A reactive Goblin
character provides immediate behavioral feedback — annoyed, angry,
or cheerful depending on session behavior. Recovery nudges pull
users back after a slip instead of treating distraction as session
failure. XP, streaks, and companion affinity build focus as a
long-term habit.

## How it differs from competitors
- vs Forest: Forest motivates passively with a virtual tree.
  CogniFocus actively blocks apps and reacts in real time.
- vs Stay Focused: Stay Focused enforces pre-set schedules.
  CogniFocus reacts at the moment distraction happens.
- vs AppBlock: AppBlock automates rules via profiles and location
  triggers. CogniFocus provides real-time reactive accountability 
  during active sessions.
- vs Freedom: Freedom blocks across all devices on a schedule.
  CogniFocus reacts in real time on a single device during a session.

## Pricing
Free tier includes core focus timer, app blocking during sessions,
Goblin reactions, and streak tracking. Pro unlocks stronger Shield
capacity, Manual Block mode, planned session scheduling, reminders,
and session restore support.
